stages.title: Part 7: Reading Comprehension (Questions 147-149)
stages.instructions: Read the following text and answer the questions below.
stages.passageText:
Email
From: j.smith@globex.com
To: Marketing Team
Subject: Upcoming Trade Show

Team, I wanted to confirm that our booth space for the Tokyo Electronics Expo has been secured. The event runs from September 14 to 18. We need to ship our promotional materials by the end of this month to ensure they clear customs in time. Sarah, please coordinate with the shipping department. Also, the hotel reservations are booked at the Grand Plaza, which is just a ten-minute walk from the convention center. Let me know if you have any questions.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email? (Question 147)
opts: (C) To provide updates about a trade show
(D) To introduce a new team member
questions.ans: (C) To provide updates about a trade show

questions.q: When must the promotional materials be shipped? (Question 148)
opts: (C) By the end of the month
questions.ans: (C) By the end of the month

questions.q: What is mentioned about the hotel? (Question 149)
opts: (B) It is close to the convention center.
questions.ans: (B) It is close to the convention center.

stages.passageText: Advertisement\nLooking for a reliable catering service for your next corporate event? Tasty Bites Catering offers premium quality food at competitive prices. stages.title: Part 7: Reading Comprehension (Questions 153-155)
stages.instructions: Read the following text and answer the questions below.
stages.passageText:
News Article
Business Daily - October 4

Local startup GreenEnergy Solutions has just secured $5 million in funding from a group of international investors. The company, which specializes in affordable solar panels for residential homes, plans to use the money to build a new manufacturing plant on the outskirts of the city. "This funding will allow us to double our production capacity and hire 200 new workers," said CEO Amanda Lewis. Construction of the plant is set to begin in January and should be fully operational by next summer.

questions.q: What does GreenEnergy Solutions produce? (Question 153)
How much money did the company receive? (Question 154)
What will the company do with the funds? (Question 155)
